# Preserve normalized keys and the cache overwrite precedence

Current AddrBookManager iterates directories and cards in reverse order, then overwrites each normalized email key in its map. That ordering makes earlier entries in the normal iteration win when addresses overlap. The per-directory catch lets other books contribute when one enumeration throws. A scoped recommendation is to retain both key normalization and the documented ordering when optimizing this cache; an arbitrary traversal order can change which card is returned. Whitespace-only inputs and duplicate-card edge cases were not executed. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: Address-book cache key and precedence.
